slug: 2025-12-15 Gambia launches BANTABA 2.0, first real-time interoperable payment system

facts.fact: The Point says BANTABA 2.0 lets funds move instantly between accounts across banks, mobile money operators, fintechs and public institutions regardless of provider.

The Point says BANTABA 2.0 is a national backbone connecting banks, mobile money operators, MFIs, fintechs and PSPs through a single interoperable switch with real-time clearing and settlement, operated by Gamswitch after a pilot.
